_comment: North America stage trackers. 'nations' fills every polygon by the power that holds it (src/us/powers.json). 'states' fills Newberry's U.S. polygons by their TERR_TYPE, as Newberry classifies them; everything else is muted. 'cessions' shades the Royce land cessions made up to the date shown, stepped by period (a sequential key: darker is later); everything else is muted.

population.title: Native population
population._comment: From the first full census (1890) the states and territories are shaded by American Indians counted per 1,000 km² (src/us/native.js DENSITY_BREAKS, the same steps every year), with the largest counts as number badges. Before 1890 the census left most Native people out, so nothing is shaded: the scholarly estimates of data/us/native-estimates.csv speak instead, as badges with their ranges, and the national figure as a line of the legend.

electoral.title: Electoral College
electoral._comment: The latest presidential election held by the date shown, drawn on the map of its own day: each state filled by the candidate its electors voted for most (src/us/parties.json gives each party's fill), with its electoral votes as a number badge. Votes from the U.S. National Archives (data/us/electoral.json, scripts/fetch-electoral.mjs). Territories, and the District of Columbia before 1964, had no electors and stay muted.
